text: This application proposes to amend the Zoning By-law to permit a 16-storey residential tower above an existing 5-storey parkade (with a total height of 21 storeys, or 66 metres, inclusive of the mechanical penthouse) at 396 Queens Quay West. It also includes additions to the existing buildings at 390 and 396 Queens Quay West, as well as interior and exterior alterations at 350, 370 and 390 Queens Quay West. Overall, the proposal will introduce 249 new dwelling units, 43 new hotel suites, and public realm enhancements along Queens Quay West. This report reviews and recommends approval of the application to amend the Zoning By-law. The proposed new tower and building additions are at appropriate scales for the site and surrounding area.
